en.themeFallbackDescription: A distinct look for Claude Aura.
en.navHintBody: The Aura button is at the bottom-right of the window. Click it to open Studio, or right-click for more options.
en.chooseThemeFolder: Choose a Claude Aura theme kit folder.
en.themeAlreadyInstalled: A theme named {0} is already installed.
en.themeCopyReady: Theme copy is ready to customize.
en.themeDeleted: Theme was deleted from this device.
en.themeEditSaveFailed: The theme could not be saved. Your draft and last valid look are still available.
en.themeDeleteFailed: The theme could not be deleted. No other themes were changed.
en.themeLayerImageFailed: The image could not be imported. Choose a supported image smaller than 16 MB.
en.themeEditFailed: That change could not be applied. Review the editor and try again.
en.noThemes: No Claude Aura themes are available.
en.gallerySubtitle: Select a theme to apply it right away. Press Escape to close.
en.customizeDescription: Choose a theme. {0} is currently selected.
en.themeApplyDescription: {0} Select to apply it right away.
en.themeSavedMessage: Your choice was saved, but Claude Aura could not show it right now. It will try again the next time Claude loads.
en.themeNotChangedMessage: That theme could not be applied. Your previous look is still available.
en.invalidBackgroundMessage: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, or AVIF image smaller than 16 MB.
en.removeBackgroundMessage: Claude Aura could not remove the background image.
en.appearanceNotChangedMessage: Claude Aura could not change the appearance right now.
en.desktopNotFoundMessage: Install the official Claude Desktop app, then try this button again.
en.continueSigningIn: Continue signing in; Aura will apply automatically.
en.loadFailed: Claude could not load. Check your connection, then retry.
en.reloadRetry: Claude needs to reload. Press Retry.
en.openedRetry: Claude opened, but the theme needs another try. Press Retry.
en.startupMessage: Claude Aura could not start its browser window. Install or repair the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, then try again.

zh-CN.navHintBody: Aura 按钮位于窗口右下角。点击可打开工作室，右键可查看更多选项。

zh-CN.themeEditDiscarded: 未保存的主题更改已丢弃。

zh-CN.chooseBackgroundTitle: 选择 Claude Aura 背景
zh-CN.invalidBackgroundMessage: 请选择小于 16 MB 的 PNG、JPEG、WebP、GIF 或 AVIF 图片。

zh-CN.desktopNotFoundMessage: 请安装官方 Claude 桌面版，然后重试。
zh-CN.continueSigningIn: 请继续登录；Aura 会自动应用主题。
